notes.title: IDUN Major Update & Steam Spring Sale – Get 15% Off!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/c0fe8eaee853ed7945f09275edd262dd7e3aa7db.gif[/img]

IDUN hits Build 100 with a massive update! A new cinematic wraps up the story, and Ro-Ro joins as a deployable hero after finishing the campaign. Extreme Difficulty & Epic Raids unlocks for those who seek the ultimate challenge. Rock Piercer is now a fully implemented hero! The game is now fully localized in Russian and Korean, big thanks to everyone who helped out! 

[b]We're currently part of the Steam Spring Sale! IDUN is now available at a 15% discount, so if you’ve enjoyed Prologue, now’s the perfect time to jump into the full experience![/b]

[b]Ready for the next challenge? Upgrade from Prologue to the full game now and experience everything IDUN has to offer! [/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2186360/IDUN/

[h3]Added:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New cinematic when finishing the last mission (Drill or Die).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/fadd60e05dabdf28fa69634df183ac5bf32b921b.jpg[/img]

[*] Ro-Ro becomes a deployable hero after completing the story campaign. Play Drill or Die to unlock!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/2c6648c61283ed9f6b01a42b1f3e0ab9a28e5ddf.gif[/img]

[*] Full localization in Russian and Korean.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/6d5ec5401f13adf58fb7a87cc8767a52bd83fcad.jpg[/img]

[*] Extreme Difficulty unlocks after finishing the story campaign. Survive Deep Drill for 10 minutes, mine 95% with the Excavator, and collect 10 meteors with the Mech.
[*] Epic-length Raids unlock after the story campaign. Almost twice as long as Long Raids!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/a7c507b908a6db2d5c737e069342156d036ce724.png[/img]

[*] Rock Piercer is now an upgradeable hero with deployable abilities. Play Convoy to unlock.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358829/8fc8621756c75a0df83614bbcbb2fdc55c2337b1.gif[/img]
[/list]

This is a huge milestone for IDUN, and it's all thanks to you! Keep sharing your feedback, and let me know what you think of the new heroes and epic challenges!

notes.title: Patch Notes: Build 0.91 "Re-Rolls & Bans"
notes.content:
Take control of your rewards with the new Re-roll and Ban systems, improved mission balancing, and significant fixes based on player feedback. Explore a more polished experience with better visual and enhanced gameplay options.

[h3]Added[/h3]
[list]
[*] Pink cursor option.
[*] Screen Resolution dropdown in Settings.
[*] Slow Motion (Reduced Game Speed) toggle can now be bound to a key in Settings.
[*] Reward Re-roll: Refresh your options with a limited number of re-rolls per mission.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115909/47c4ed32a6ad26ac64df861e9a85f019b82a72e5.jpg[/img]
[*] Reward Ban: Remove a reward option for the rest of the mission with a limited number of bans per mission.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115909/a0b31be6ad0506974b7714b9ced146459b2f3ac9.jpg[/img]
[*] Pre-Lightning Strike warning effect.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115909/e736507010d9da7a640208f011c318b5ac7fcffa.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Walls start count increased from 1 to 3.
[*] Deep Drill minimum distance from edges increased from 10 to 20 meters.
[*] Deep Drill Smallest mission smallest size increased from 60 to 70.
[*] Nuke On Wheels trigger distance increased from 8 to 8.5.
[*] Spear Spitters stand closer to targets (distance reduced from 400 to 300).
[*] Mech Mission Meteor collection reward distance increased from 10 to 12.
[*] Lightning Strike won't hit the same spot twice in a row.
[*] Excavator changes:
[list]
[*] Epli reward from mining mountains increased by 33%.
[*] Health increased from 10000 to 12000
[/list]
[/list]

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Analytics data collection is now off by default.
[*] Time between dormant spawn wave warnings increased from 30 to 40 seconds.
[*] Holding Shift with Traditional controls always triggers box selection (no accidental dragging).
[*] Turret Tooltip now displays Aim Speed (Rotation Rate).
[*] Selection Modifier input is now rebindable (default: Shift).
[*] Control Group input is now rebindable (default: CTRL). Press CTRL + # to create control groups.
[*] Updated Raid information screenshots.
[*] Mech Proximity Mine on step no longer exponential.
[*] No Monster Tunnel openings on small maps.
[/list]

Fixes
[list]
[*] Mech Collectibles can't be moved with dragged turrets or hero destination targets.
[*] UI toggle for "Send Analytics Data" shows the correct state (off by default).
[*] Wall health upgrades apply properly.
[*] Bomber Cooldown reduction functions correctly.
[*] Soldier Air printing uses the correct base value.
[*] Droppable items no longer disappear if dropped on invalid locations too quickly.
[*] Nuke On Wheels Mission shows correct time on objectives before starting.
[*] Full-screen mode setting now works.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115909/5e7d175d10ea41ebfedf60be983e12bc81080b63.gif[/img]

Thank you so much for playing the Prologue. I would highly recommend you to check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2186360/]IDUN[/url] for more awesomeness!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2186360/IDUN/

After the official launch of our game, we’ve received attention from players all over the world. Many players from certain regions have expressed a strong desire for localized versions in their native languages. To address this, we are actively working with new translation companies to make this happen. In the first phase, we will be adding [b]Korean, Russian, and other localized languages.[/b]

We’re excited about the possibility of more players around the world enjoying the game in their native language. If you’d like to see your language added, please let us know in the comments so we can carefully evaluate the demand—your feedback is invaluable!

As an indie team, our resources are limited, so if you’re interested in contributing as a volunteer translator, your help would be greatly appreciated in speeding up the process. If you’d like to get involved, feel free to leave a comment or join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/KRXDNETCnh][b]Discord[/b][/url] to discuss this with us. Thank you!!!

notes.title: Ready to Roll? The IDUN Launch FAQ!
notes.content:
[b]IDUN[/b] is officially launching on [b]January 20th[/b], and we’ve prepared an FAQ to help answer any questions you might have. Thank you for your incredible support—we couldn’t have done this without you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2186360/IDUN/

[b]Q: What is the exact launch time?[/b]
[b]A: [/b]January 20th at [b]9:00 AM PST.[/b]

[b]Q: Will it launch in Early Access?[/b]
[b]A: [/b]No, the full game will be available at launch!

[b]Q: What’s the price? Will there be a launch discount?[/b]
[b]A: [/b]The game is priced at [b]$14.99[/b] and will have a [b]10% launch discount.[/b]

[b]Q: Can I stream the game after it’s released?[/b]
[b]A: [/b]Absolutely! We encourage you to stream and share all the content freely.

[b]Q: What modes are included in the game?[/b]
[b]A: [/b]The game features [b]Campaign Story Mode[/b] and a [b]Roguelike Raid Mode.[/b]

[b]Q: Will the game receive updates after launch?[/b]
[b]A: [/b]Yes, we will continue to support the game with updates after launch, including balance adjustments, bug fixes, and more. We’re also looking forward to hearing player feedback to inspire new content in future updates.

[b]Q: How can I provide feedback or suggestions?[/b]
[b]A:[/b]
[list]
[*] In-game feedback window
[*] Discord: https://discord.com/invite/KRXDNETCnh
[*] Steam Community
[/list]

I can't believe it—our game is finally about to officially launch! Let's look forward to the arrival of the full build together! We are incredibly grateful for all the support from our players and we couldn’t have done it without you!

Best wishes!
